observations: Used car engine and gearbox assembly.

risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine's identification plate (usually on the side or front).

risks.risk: The gearbox may be a different model or have internal damage.
risks.proof: A photo of the gearbox's identification plate.

risks.risk: The engine may be missing the necessary oil pan or other components.
risks.proof: A photo showing the complete engine with the oil pan and all necessary fittings.
risks.if_unproven: as a bare engine with missing pan

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the engine's identification plate.
Photo of the gearbox's identification plate.
Photo of the complete engine with the oil pan and all fittings.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
